title: Night Out
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael seeks a remedy for gum in his hair, discusses his dating life, and plans a night out in New York with Ryan. The group encounters club entry issues, socializes with various characters, and Ryan's experiences at the club lead to Ryan getting sick. The episode concludes with Michael reflecting on Ryan's night and their friendship.
